done_when: The worker brief names the plan's files and related tests, tells the worker not to read the coordinator guide, answers 'separate fix?' and 'record a narrow choice' in advance (out-of-scope problems become Spotted lines; fix only findings inside the Done-when and list the rest in the proof), and ends with the reviewer's checklist the worker checks before handing over

findings.body: Raise: Not done. A worker whose session began before a Forge upgrade can resume without receiving the new instruction to skip the coordinator guide, leaving the reported reread problem on a normal upgrade path. The instruction is in the full template at `src/forge/templates/brief.md:13`, but the continued path at `src/forge/worker.py:444-464` builds a shorter brief that omits it. The added test checks this instruction only in the first brief, even for its earlier-adopted client fixture; it does not start a session before upgrading.
findings.title: Not done: The worker brief names the plan's files and related tests, tells the worker not to read the coordinator guide, answers 'separate'

why: Worker turns take about 22 minutes: workers re-read the 15,000-word guide and search the whole repo, ask the same two questions, and fail 45% of first reviews
